recorded_stage: Before candidate extraction or visual inspection of acquired block imagery
soil_colour_index: (red-green)/(red+green), reflectance scale/offset applied from each asset
contrast_normalization: Within each block/date, residual divided by1.4826*MAD of valid-land residuals, minimum scale0.005
ranking: Mean absolute soil-colour contrast multiplied byfraction of usable dates above threshold; review order only
terrain_descriptor: DSM patch median minus100–400m surrounding annulus median; nativeDEM support retained, no archaeological probability
limits: Exploratory image screening. Thresholds are not learned or calibrated as archaeological sensitivity/specificity. Persistent compact anomalies may be natural or modern. Apparent polygons describe a detector-selected optical patch, not an occupied footprint.
